prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: NEW transparent four-direction full-body IDLE source atlas for HUMAN Zou Run (邹润) in an isometric Chinese historical RTS. One consistent character, four views, not a walking strip, no text.
Input1 is the named PORTRAIT/IDENTITY reference: mature human face, dark mustache/short goatee, dark topknot and red-brown forehead band, red cloth/bronze-brown armor, ONE fleshy rounded prominence at the BACK of his head behind the ear below bun. Input2 is the OLD WALKING MODEL reference only for general full-body stature, red sleeves/trousers, brown lamellar armor, wrapped calves and simple shoes. CORRECT its forehead pointed horn and pole-mounted curved blade: do NOT copy those. No horn on the forehead, no long pole blade or bow.
Novel basis: Chapter49 says tall/large adult human, nephew but approximately same age as his uncle, one fleshy prominence at back of head, and that he draws a SHORT KNIFE. The nickname 独角龙 does not mean dragon anatomy. Create a mature, tall sturdy human with the portrait's identity, a normal unhorned forehead, and a modest rounded flesh contour naturally at the occiput/back of skull. In back views show its appropriate location; front views may naturally obscure it. Do not paste a second ear, put it on a temple, forehead or crown, or exaggerate it into a growth/medical illustration.
Pose: calm combat-ready standing, feet planted shoulder-width, knees relaxed. Exactly ONE short single-handed knife/short dao in his RIGHT hand lowered beside the thigh, blade no longer than his forearm, normal iron/steel and wooden/simple wrapped handle. Left hand naturally empty. No second blade, scabbard blade, long spear/glaive, staff, bow, quiver, horns, wings, skeletons or magic. Do not stage a story event, injury, capture or death.
Clothing: red-brown cloth forehead band tied around a dark topknot, short red cloth shirt/sleeves and red trousers beneath simple dark bronze/brown lamellar cuirass and waist panels, cloth calf bindings and low brown shoes. Consistent restrained style and colors with references. Exact clothing, knife shape and stance are game art interpretation, not literal novel costume/pose claims. No ornate animal helmet or fantasy pauldrons.
Layout: square 2x2 atlas, FOUR complete separate people at equal fixed scale and camera. Top-left SE (front three-quarter facing screen-right), top-right SW (front three-quarter facing screen-left), bottom-left NE (back three-quarter facing away screen-right), bottom-right NW (back three-quarter facing away screen-left). Correct rear views, not mirrors of fronts. Each view has the SAME one knife, identity and clothing; allow natural occlusion rather than inventing extra arms/weapons. Full head, rear-head feature where visible, hands, knife, shoes and soles all completely inside their own cell with generous transparent gutters. Equal height/foot baselines relative to each cell, no resizing individual poses to fit.
Style: small isometric game sprite, controlled dark contour, restrained ink/opaque painted shading, earthy red cloth/bronze/gray wraps, clear readable silhouette and coherent anatomy. Genuine transparent alpha background, completely clean empty gutters, no paper backdrop, ground, cast shadow, fog, gradient, stray alpha residue, checkerboard texture, text, labels, border or watermark.
